```{r Study 1} 

mediationdata <- read.xlsx('mediationdata.xlsx')

#------CFA-------

mod <- '
F =~ CT1 + CT2 + CT3 + CT4 + CT5 + CT6 + CT7 + CT8 + CT9 +
     CT10 + CT11 + CT12 + CT13 + CT14 + CT15 + CT16 + CT17 +
     CT18 + CT19 + CT20 + CT21 + CT22 + CT23 + CT24 + CT25 +
     CT26 + CT27'

fit <- cfa(mod, mediationdata, estimator="MLR")
summary(fit, standardized=TRUE, fit.measures=TRUE)

factor_scores <- lavPredict(fit, newdata = mediationdata, type = "lv", se = "standard") 
mediationdata$AI_CT_F <- factor_scores

vars <- c(
  "CT1", "CT2", "CT3", "CT4", "CT5", "CT6", "CT7", "CT8", "CT9",
  "CT10", "CT11", "CT12", "CT13", "CT14", "CT15", "CT16", "CT17",
  "CT18", "CT19", "CT20", "CT21", "CT22", "CT23", "CT24", "CT25",
  "CT26", "CT27"
)

omega(mediationdata[, vars]) # alpha = 0.94


mod <- '
PE =~ Acceptance_PE1 + Acceptance_PE2 + Acceptance_PE3 + Acceptance_PE4 + Acceptance_PE5 + Acceptance_PE6 + Acceptance_PE7 
EE =~ Acceptance_EE1 + Acceptance_EE2 + Acceptance_EE3 + Acceptance_EE4 + Acceptance_EE5 
FC =~ Acceptance_FC1 + Acceptance_FC2 + Acceptance_FC3
SI =~ Acceptance_SI1 + Acceptance_SI2 + Acceptance_SI3 + Acceptance_SI4 + Acceptance_SI5 
F =~ PE + EE + FC + SI'

fit <- cfa(mod, mediationdata, estimator="MLR")
summary(fit, standardized=TRUE, fit.measures=TRUE)

factor_scores <- lavPredict(fit, newdata = mediationdata, type = "lv", se = "standard")
mediationdata$Acceptance_F <- factor_scores[, "F"]    

vars <- c(
  "Acceptance_PE1", "Acceptance_PE2", "Acceptance_PE3", "Acceptance_PE4", 
  "Acceptance_PE5", "Acceptance_PE6", "Acceptance_PE7",
  "Acceptance_EE1", "Acceptance_EE2", "Acceptance_EE3", "Acceptance_EE4", 
  "Acceptance_EE5",
  "Acceptance_FC1", "Acceptance_FC2", "Acceptance_FC3",
  "Acceptance_SI1", "Acceptance_SI2", "Acceptance_SI3", "Acceptance_SI4", 
  "Acceptance_SI5"
)

omega(mediationdata[, vars]) # alpha = 0.89


mod <- '
F =~ Trust_humanlike1 + Trust_humanlike2 + Trust_humanlike3 + Trust_humanlike4 + Trust_humanlike5 + Trust_humanlike6 + Trust_functionality1 + Trust_functionality2 + Trust_functionality3 + Trust_functionality4 + Trust_functionality5'

fit <- cfa(mod, mediationdata, estimator="MLR")
summary(fit, standardized=TRUE, fit.measures=TRUE)

factor_scores <- lavPredict(fit, newdata = mediationdata, type = "lv", se = "standard")
mediationdata$Trust_F <- factor_scores[, "F"]   

vars <- c(
  "Trust_humanlike1", "Trust_humanlike2", "Trust_humanlike3", "Trust_humanlike4", 
  "Trust_humanlike5", "Trust_humanlike6", "Trust_functionality1",
  "Trust_functionality2", "Trust_functionality3", "Trust_functionality4", "Trust_functionality5"
)

omega(mediationdata[, vars]) # 0.92


mediationdata$frequency <- factor(mediationdata$frequency, levels = c('monthly',"weekly","daily"), ordered = TRUE) 

mod <- '
embed =~ scenario_diversity + activity_diversity + AI_diversity + frequency'

fit <- cfa(mod, data = mediationdata, ordered = c('frequency'))
summary(fit, standardized=TRUE, fit.measures=TRUE)

factor_scores <- lavPredict(fit, newdata = mediationdata, type = "lv") 
mediationdata$embed_F <- factor_scores[,1]


#------Mediation model-------

model_path <- '
  embed_F ~ a1*Acceptance_F
  AI_CT_F ~ a2*Acceptance_F
  
  Trust_F ~ b1*embed_F + b2*AI_CT_F + cprime1*Acceptance_F
  
  ind_F1    := a1*b1
  ind_F2    := a2*b2'

set.seed(123)

mediation_mod <- sem(model_path, data = mediationdata,
           estimator="ML",
           se="bootstrap", bootstrap=5000)

summary(mediation_mod, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)

parameterestimates(mediation_mod, 
                   boot.ci.type = "perc",
                   level = 0.95, 
                   ci = TRUE) |> 
  dplyr::filter(op == ":=")


```

```{r Study 2}

#-----experiment-----

experiment <- read.xlsx('experiment.xlsx')
  
experiment$diff_trust <- experiment$AI_Trust_avg_post - experiment$AI_Trust_avg_pre

experiment$diff_AI_CT <- experiment$AI_CT_avg_post - experiment$AI_CT_avg_pre

experiment <- experiment %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      condition == 'withAI' & diff_AI_CT > 0.14 ~ 'Increased CT group',
      condition == 'withAI' & diff_AI_CT <= 0.14 ~ 'Non-increased CT group',
      condition ==  'withoutAI' ~ 'Independent work group',
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

cols_trust <- c("AI_Trust_avg_pre", "AI_Trust_avg_post")

data_trust <- experiment %>%
  dplyr::select(group, all_of(cols_trust)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cols_trust), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.x))))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(cols_trust),
    names_to = "var",
    values_to = "value"
  )

data_trust <- data_trust %>%
  mutate(var = recode(var,
                      "AI_Trust_avg_pre" = "Pre-test",
                      "AI_Trust_avg_post" = "Post-test"))

group_order <- c('Increased CT group', 'Non-increased CT group', 'Independent work group')

time_order <- c("Pre-test", "Post-test") 

data_trust$group <- factor(data_trust$group, levels = group_order)
data_trust$var <- factor(data_trust$var, levels = time_order)

data_trust <- data_trust %>%
  mutate(
    var = factor(var, levels = c("Pre-test", "Post-test")),  
    group_time = paste(group, var, sep = "_")
  )

p <- ggplot(data_trust, aes(x = group, y = value, fill = interaction(group, var))) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", 
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), 
               width = 0.6,
               aes(group = var)) +  
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(3, 7)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(3, 7, 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Increased CT group.Pre-test" = "#A8E6CF",
      "Increased CT group.Post-test" = "#56C596",
      "Non-increased CT group.Pre-test" = "#B9CCED",
      "Non-increased CT group.Post-test" = "#6B9BD1",
      "Independent work group.Pre-test" = "#D4C5E2",
      "Independent work group.Post-test" = "#9B7EBD"
    ),
    labels = c("Increased-Pre", "Increased-Post", 
               "Non-increased-Pre", "Non-increased-Post",
               "Independent-Pre", "Independent-Post")
  ) +
  labs(title = "", x = " ", y = "AI Trust", fill = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold",color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold",color = "black"),
    panel.background = element_blank(),  
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90"), 
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )


#----ANCOVA-----

ancova_data <- experiment %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c('Increased CT group', 'Non-increased CT group', 'Independent work group')), 
    pre = as.numeric(as.character(AI_Trust_avg_pre)), 
    diff = as.numeric(as.character(AI_Trust_avg_post)) - as.numeric(as.character(AI_Trust_avg_pre))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(group, pre, diff) %>% 
  na.omit() 

ancova_data$group <- as.factor(ancova_data$group)

ancova_result <- aov(diff ~ group + pre, data = ancova_data)
summary(ancova_result)

tukey_result <- TukeyHSD(ancova_result, "group")
print(tukey_result)


data_condition1 <- experiment %>%
  filter(group == 'Increased CT group') %>%
  dplyr::select(AI_Trust_avg_pre, AI_Trust_avg_post) %>%
  mutate(
    AI_Trust_avg_pre = as.numeric(as.character(AI_Trust_avg_pre)),
    AI_Trust_avg_post = as.numeric(as.character(AI_Trust_avg_post))
  )

t.test(
  data_condition1$AI_Trust_avg_pre, 
  data_condition1$AI_Trust_avg_post,
  paired = TRUE
) # t = 4.509, df = 45, p = 0.000 mean difference: 0.296


data_condition2 <- experiment %>%
  filter(group == 'Non-increased CT group') %>%
  dplyr::select(AI_Trust_avg_pre, AI_Trust_avg_post) %>%
  mutate(
    AI_Trust_avg_pre = as.numeric(as.character(AI_Trust_avg_pre)),
    AI_Trust_avg_post = as.numeric(as.character(AI_Trust_avg_post))
  )

t.test(
  data_condition2$AI_Trust_avg_pre, 
  data_condition2$AI_Trust_avg_post,
  paired = TRUE
) # t = 1.284, df = 42, p = 0.206 mean difference: 0.099


data_condition3 <- experiment %>%
  filter(group == 'Independent work group') %>%
  dplyr::select(AI_Trust_avg_pre, AI_Trust_avg_post) %>%
  mutate(
    AI_Trust_avg_pre = as.numeric(as.character(AI_Trust_avg_pre)),
    AI_Trust_avg_post = as.numeric(as.character(AI_Trust_avg_post))
  )

t.test(
  data_condition3$AI_Trust_avg_pre, 
  data_condition3$AI_Trust_avg_post,
  paired = TRUE
) # t = 0.243, df = 39, p = 0.810 mean difference: 0.023


#------logfile: single behavior------

experiment_logfile <- read.xlsx('experiment_logfile.xlsx')

experiment_logfile %>%
  mutate(
    n_missing = rowSums(
      is.na(dplyr::select(.,
                   decide_based_on_AI_r1,
                   decide_based_on_AI_r2,
                   decide_based_on_AI_r3,
                   decide_based_on_AI_r4))
    )
  ) %>%
  count(n_missing)

experiment_logfile %>%
  mutate(
    n_missing = rowSums(
      is.na(.[, c(
        "decide_based_on_AI_r1",
        "decide_based_on_AI_r2",
        "decide_based_on_AI_r3",
        "decide_based_on_AI_r4"
      )])
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(n_missing >= 1) %>%
  count(group, n_missing) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = n_missing,
    values_from = n,
    names_prefix = "missing_",
    values_fill = 0
  )


experiment_logfile <- experiment_logfile %>%
  filter(
    rowSums(!is.na(dplyr::select(., decide_based_on_AI_r1, decide_based_on_AI_r2, decide_based_on_AI_r3, decide_based_on_AI_r4))) >= 2
  )

variables <- c(
  "sum_total_row", 
  'sum_assign_task',
'sum_assign_alltask',
'sum_assign_subtask',
  "sum_guide_AI_to_optimize_general", 
  "sum_guide_AI_to_optimize_specific",
  "sum_generate_own_idea", 
  "sum_ask_AI_to_organise_content",
  "sum_question_AI_solution", 
  "sum_ask_for_suggestion_refinement",
  "sum_ask_for_explanation",
  'sum_decide_based_on_AI'
)

result_table <- data.frame(
  Variable = variables,
  Mean_Group1 = numeric(length(variables)),
  Mean_Group2 = numeric(length(variables))
)

for (i in seq_along(variables)) {
  var <- variables[i]
  group_means <- tapply(experiment_logfile[[var]], experiment_logfile$group, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  result_table$Mean_Group1[i] <- round(group_means[1],2)
  result_table$Mean_Group2[i] <- round(group_means[2],2)
}

print(result_table)

total_group1 <- result_table$Mean_Group1[result_table$Variable == "sum_total_row"]
total_group2 <- result_table$Mean_Group2[result_table$Variable == "sum_total_row"]

result_table$Percent_Group1 <- round(result_table$Mean_Group1 / total_group1 * 100, 3)
result_table$Percent_Group2 <- round(result_table$Mean_Group2 / total_group2 * 100, 3)
result_table$diff <- result_table$Percent_Group1 - result_table$Percent_Group2

View(result_table)

#-------2gram------

experiment_2gram <- read.xlsx("experiment_2step.xlsx")

experiment_2gram <- experiment_2gram %>%
  filter(behavior != "meaningless") %>%
  filter(ID != '10112') # delete the one providing only 1 wave log

order_check <- experiment_2gram %>%
  group_by(round, ID) %>%
  summarise(
    is_sorted = all(input_timestamp == sort(input_timestamp)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

experiment_2gram <- experiment_2gram %>%
  group_by(round, ID) %>%
  mutate(
    next_behavior = lead(behavior), 
    `2gram` = ifelse(is.na(next_behavior), "", paste0(behavior, "_to_", next_behavior))  
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

gram_freq <- experiment_2gram %>%
  filter(`2gram` != "") %>%
  group_by(group, `2gram`) %>%
  summarise(freq = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(group, desc(freq))

total_by_group <- gram_freq %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(total_sequence = sum(freq))

gram_prop <- gram_freq %>%
  left_join(total_by_group, by = "group") %>%
  mutate(pp = round((freq / total_sequence * 100),2))

gram_wide <- gram_prop %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = `2gram`,
    names_from = group,
    values_from = pp,
    values_fill = 0
  )

gram_wide <- gram_wide %>%
  mutate(diff = `Increased CT group` - `Non-increased CT group`)

View(gram_wide)
```

```{r Study 3}

df_final <- read.xlsx('sliding_windows.xlsx')

target_quarters <- c(
  "2026-Q2", "2026-Q1", 
  "2025-Q4", "2025-Q3", "2025-Q2", "2025-Q1", 
  "2024-Q4", "2024-Q3", "2024-Q2", "2024-Q1", 
  "2023-Q4", "2023-Q3", "2023-Q2", "2023-Q1"
)

df_final <- df_final %>%
  mutate(first_regular_quarter = factor(first_regular_quarter, levels = target_quarters))

# Acceptance

mod <- '
PE =~ PE1 + PE2 + PE3 + PE4 + PE5 + PE6 + PE7
EE =~ EE1 + EE2 + EE3 + EE4 + EE5
FC =~ FC1 + FC2 + FC3
SI =~ SI1 + SI2 + SI3 + SI4 + SI5
F =~ PE + EE + FC + SI'

fit <- cfa(mod, df_final, estimator="MLR")
summary(fit, standardized=TRUE, fit.measures=TRUE)

factor_scores <- lavPredict(fit, newdata = df_final, type = "lv", se = "standard")

df_final$Acceptance_F <- factor_scores[, "F"]    

vars_acceptance <- c(
  "PE1", "PE2", "PE3", "PE4", "PE5", "PE6", "PE7",
  "EE1", "EE2", "EE3", "EE4", "EE5",
  "FC1", "FC2", "FC3",
  "SI1", "SI2", "SI3", "SI4", "SI5"
)

omega(df_final[, vars_acceptance])


# AI_CT

mod <- 'AI_CT_F =~ AI_CT1 + AI_CT2 + AI_CT3 + AI_CT4 + AI_CT5 + AI_CT6 + 
        AI_CT7 + AI_CT8 + AI_CT9 + AI_CT10 + AI_CT11 + AI_CT12 + AI_CT13 + AI_CT14 + AI_CT15 + AI_CT16 + AI_CT17 + AI_CT18 + AI_CT19 + AI_CT20 + AI_CT21 + AI_CT22 + AI_CT23 + AI_CT24 + AI_CT25 + AI_CT26 + AI_CT27'

fit <- cfa(mod, df_final, estimator="MLR")
summary(fit, standardized=TRUE, fit.measures=TRUE)

factor_scores <- lavPredict(fit, newdata = df_final, type = "lv", se = "standard") 

df_final$AI_CT_F <- factor_scores

vars_CT <- c(
  "AI_CT1", "AI_CT2", "AI_CT3",
  "AI_CT4", "AI_CT5", "AI_CT6",
  "AI_CT7", "AI_CT8", "AI_CT9", "AI_CT10",
  "AI_CT11", "AI_CT12", "AI_CT13", "AI_CT14",
  "AI_CT15", "AI_CT16", "AI_CT17", "AI_CT18", "AI_CT19",
  "AI_CT20", "AI_CT21",
  "AI_CT22", "AI_CT23", "AI_CT24","AI_CT25",
  "AI_CT26", "AI_CT27"
)

omega(df_final[, vars_CT])


# Embeddedness

df_final$frequency <- factor(
  df_final$frequency,
  levels = c('Several times a month or less', 
             'Several times a week, but not every day', 
             'About once a day', 
             'Multiple times a day'), 
  ordered = TRUE
)

mod <- '
embed_F =~ scenario_diversity + activity_diversity + AI_diversity + frequency'

fit <- cfa(mod, data = df_final, ordered = c('frequency'))
summary(fit, standardized=TRUE, fit.measures=TRUE)

factor_scores <- lavPredict(fit, newdata = df_final, type = "lv") 
df_final$embed_F <- factor_scores[,1]

# Trust

F_trust =~ trust1 + trust2 + trust3 + trust4 + trust5 + trust6 + trust7 + trust8 + trust9 + trust10 + trust11'

    n = n()  
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(first_regular_quarter) %>%    
  mutate(Time_Index = row_number())  

p_trust <- ggplot(plot_trust, aes(x = Time_Index, y = mean_trust)) +
  geom_line(color = "gray80", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.8) +
  geom_point(color = "gray80", size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(
    aes(weight = n), 
    method = "loess", 
    span = 0.8, 
    method.args = list(degree = 1),
    se = TRUE, 
    color = "black", 
    size = 2
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = plot_trust$Time_Index, 
    labels = as.character(plot_trust$first_regular_quarter),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.10, 0.10))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.6, 0.40)) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = " ",
    x = " ",
    y = " "
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5,size=10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size=11),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

library(gridExtra)
library(grid)

)

)

  AI_CT_F ~ a2*Acceptance_F 
  
  F_trust ~ b1*embed_F + b2*AI_CT_F + cprime1*Acceptance_F
  
  ind_F1    := a1*b1
  ind_F2    := a2*b2
'

group0 <- df_final[df_final$first_regular_quarter %in% c("2025-Q3","2025-Q4","2026-Q1","2026-Q2"), ]

library(purrr)

models_list <- list(
  "25_3 to 26_2" = mediation_mod0,
  "25_2 to 26_1" = mediation_mod1,
  "25_1 to 25_4" = mediation_mod2,
  "24_4 to 25_3" = mediation_mod3,
  "24_3 to 25_2" = mediation_mod4,
  "24_2 to 25_1" = mediation_mod5,
  "24_1 to 24_4" = mediation_mod6,
  "23_4 to 24_3" = mediation_mod7,
  "23_3 to 24_2" = mediation_mod8,
  "23_2 to 24_1" = mediation_mod9
)

coef_order <- c("a1", "a2", "b1", "b2", "cprime1", "ind_F1", "ind_F2")

extract_coefs <- function(mod, col_name) {
  lavaan::parameterEstimates(mod) %>%
    dplyr::filter(label %in% coef_order) %>%
    dplyr::select(label, est, pvalue) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      !!paste0(col_name, "_est") := est,
      !!paste0(col_name, "_p") := pvalue
    )
}

final_table <- purrr::imap(models_list, extract_coefs) %>%
  purrr::reduce(dplyr::full_join, by = "label") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(match(label, coef_order))

a1_values <- final_table %>%
  dplyr::filter(label == "a1") %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::ends_with("_est")) %>%

  dplyr::select(dplyr::ends_with("_p")) %>%
```

```{r Study 4: AI Models}
#-----variable trajectory difference test----

# trust

set.seed(42)

B <- 2000
time_grid <- seq(1, 13, by = 1)
loess_span <- 0.8

make_trend <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      group = ifelse(GPT + Claude + Gemini >= 1, "high", "other"),
      Time_Index = as.numeric(first_regular_quarter)
    ) %>%
    group_by(group, Time_Index) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = mean(F_trust, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = sum(!is.na(F_trust)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(mean), n > 0) %>%
    arrange(group, Time_Index)
}

get_loess_diff <- function(df_trend_b, time_grid, span = 0.8) {
  
  df_high_b <- df_trend_b %>%
    filter(group == "high")
  
  df_other_b <- df_trend_b %>%
    filter(group == "other")
  
  if (nrow(df_high_b) < 5 || nrow(df_other_b) < 5) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(time_grid)))
  }
  
  fit_h <- tryCatch(
    loess(
      mean ~ Time_Index,
      data = df_high_b,
      weights = n,
      span = span,
      degree = 1,
      control = loess.control(surface = "direct")
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  fit_o <- tryCatch(
    loess(
      mean ~ Time_Index,
      data = df_other_b,
      weights = n,
      span = span,
      degree = 1,
      control = loess.control(surface = "direct")
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(fit_h) || is.null(fit_o)) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(time_grid)))
  }
  
  pred_h <- tryCatch(
    predict(
      fit_h,
      newdata = data.frame(Time_Index = time_grid)
    ),
    error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(time_grid))
  )
  
  pred_o <- tryCatch(
    predict(
      fit_o,
      newdata = data.frame(Time_Index = time_grid)
    ),
    error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(time_grid))
  )
  
  pred_h - pred_o
}

df_trend_orig <- make_trend(df_final)

diff_point <- get_loess_diff(
  df_trend_b = df_trend_orig,
  time_grid = time_grid,
  span = loess_span
)

boot_diff <- replicate(B, {
  
  boot_df <- df_final %>%
    slice_sample(
      n = nrow(df_final),
      replace = TRUE
    )
  
  df_trend_b <- make_trend(boot_df)
  
  get_loess_diff(
    df_trend_b = df_trend_b,
    time_grid = time_grid,
    span = loess_span
  )
})

ci_lower <- apply(
  boot_diff,
  1,
  quantile,
  probs = 0.025,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

ci_upper <- apply(
  boot_diff,
  1,
  quantile,
  probs = 0.975,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

trust_models_diff <- tibble(
  Time_Index = time_grid,
  diff = diff_point,
  lower = ci_lower,
  upper = ci_upper
)


ymax_trust_models <- max(abs(c(trust_models_diff$lower, trust_models_diff$upper, trust_models_diff$diff)), na.rm = TRUE)

p_trust_models_diff <- ggplot(trust_models_diff, aes(x = Time_Index, y = diff)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
    fill = "gray80",
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    color = "darkred",
    linewidth = 1,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_line(
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 2
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = time_grid,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-ymax_trust_models, ymax_trust_models),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05)),
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    title = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "white"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),  
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black"), 
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5)
  )

print(p_trust_models_diff)

# CT

set.seed(42)

B <- 2000
time_grid <- seq(1, 13, by = 1)
loess_span <- 0.8

make_trend <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      group = ifelse(GPT + Claude + Gemini >= 1, "high", "other"),
      Time_Index = as.numeric(first_regular_quarter)
    ) %>%
    group_by(group, Time_Index) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = mean(AI_CT_F, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = sum(!is.na(AI_CT_F)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(mean), n > 0) %>%
    arrange(group, Time_Index)
}

get_loess_diff <- function(df_trend_b, time_grid, span = 0.8) {
  
  df_high_b <- df_trend_b %>%
    filter(group == "high")
  
  df_other_b <- df_trend_b %>%
    filter(group == "other")
  
  if (nrow(df_high_b) < 5 || nrow(df_other_b) < 5) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(time_grid)))
  }
  
  fit_h <- tryCatch(
    loess(
      mean ~ Time_Index,
      data = df_high_b,
      weights = n,
      span = span,
      degree = 1,
      control = loess.control(surface = "direct")
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  fit_o <- tryCatch(
    loess(
      mean ~ Time_Index,
      data = df_other_b,
      weights = n,
      span = span,
      degree = 1,
      control = loess.control(surface = "direct")
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(fit_h) || is.null(fit_o)) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(time_grid)))
  }
  
  pred_h <- tryCatch(
    predict(
      fit_h,
      newdata = data.frame(Time_Index = time_grid)
    ),
    error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(time_grid))
  )
  
  pred_o <- tryCatch(
    predict(
      fit_o,
      newdata = data.frame(Time_Index = time_grid)
    ),
    error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(time_grid))
  )
  
  pred_h - pred_o
}

df_trend_orig <- make_trend(df_final)

diff_point <- get_loess_diff(
  df_trend_b = df_trend_orig,
  time_grid = time_grid,
  span = loess_span
)

boot_diff <- replicate(B, {
  
  boot_df <- df_final %>%
    slice_sample(
      n = nrow(df_final),
      replace = TRUE
    )
  
  df_trend_b <- make_trend(boot_df)
  
  get_loess_diff(
    df_trend_b = df_trend_b,
    time_grid = time_grid,
    span = loess_span
  )
})

ci_lower <- apply(
  boot_diff,
  1,
  quantile,
  probs = 0.025,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

ci_upper <- apply(
  boot_diff,
  1,
  quantile,
  probs = 0.975,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

CT_models_diff <- tibble(
  Time_Index = time_grid,
  diff = diff_point,
  lower = ci_lower,
  upper = ci_upper
)


ymax_CT_models <- max(abs(c(CT_models_diff$lower, CT_models_diff$upper, CT_models_diff$diff)), na.rm = TRUE)

p_CT_models_diff <- ggplot(CT_models_diff, aes(x = Time_Index, y = diff)) +

  ) +

    color = "#56C596",

  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(

coef_order <- c("a1", "a2", "b1", "b2", "cprime1", "ind_F1", "ind_F2")

extract_coefs <- function(mod, col_name) {
  lavaan::parameterEstimates(mod) %>%
    dplyr::filter(label %in% coef_order) %>%
    dplyr::select(label, est, pvalue) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      !!paste0(col_name, "_est") := est,
      !!paste0(col_name, "_p") := pvalue
    )
}

final_table <- purrr::imap(models_list, extract_coefs) %>%
  purrr::reduce(dplyr::full_join, by = "label") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(match(label, coef_order))

    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank() 
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mediation Effect of Embeddedness",
    x = " ",
    y = "Coefficient (a1 x b1)"
  )

fit <- loess(
  Value ~ Time_Index,
  data = df_ind1,
  weights = n,
  span = 1)

df_ind1$Predicted <- predict(
  fit,
  newdata = data.frame(Time_Index = df_ind1$Time_Index)
)

df_ind1


df_ind2 <- data.frame(
  Period = factor(x_labels, levels = x_labels),
  Time_Index = seq_along(x_labels),
  Value = ind2_values,
  Pvalue = ind2_pvalues,
  n = model_n_other,
  Group = 1
)

p_ind2 <- ggplot(df_ind2, aes(x = Time_Index, y = Value)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Group), color = "darkgray", linewidth = 1.2, linetype = "dashed") +

    span = 1,
    color = "#56C596",

  ) +

    breaks = df_ind2$Time_Index,
    labels = df_ind2$Period
  ) +

    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, angle = 45, hjust = 0.9, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.9, color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank() 
  ) +
  labs(

    y = "Coefficient (a2 x b2)"

df_ind2

p_ind2 <- p_ind2 + theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 8))
p_c    <- p_c    + theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 8))
```

```{r Study 4: Scenarios}
model_n <- purrr::map_int(
  models_list,
  ~ sum(lavaan::lavInspect(.x, "nobs"))
)

coef_order <- c("a1", "a2", "b1", "b2", "cprime1", "ind_F1", "ind_F2")

extract_coefs <- function(mod, col_name) {
  lavaan::parameterEstimates(mod) %>%
    dplyr::filter(label %in% coef_order) %>%
    dplyr::select(label, est, pvalue) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      !!paste0(col_name, "_est") := est,
      !!paste0(col_name, "_p") := pvalue
    )
}

final_table <- purrr::imap(models_list, extract_coefs) %>%
  purrr::reduce(dplyr::full_join, by = "label") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(match(label, coef_order))

# trust

set.seed(42)

B <- 2000
time_grid <- seq(1, 13, by = 1)
loess_span <- 0.8

make_trend <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      group = ifelse(Learning + Work >= 70, "outcome", "experience"),
      Time_Index = as.numeric(first_regular_quarter)
    ) %>%
    group_by(group, Time_Index) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = mean(F_trust, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = sum(!is.na(F_trust)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(mean), n > 0) %>%
    arrange(group, Time_Index)
}

get_loess_diff <- function(df_trend_b, time_grid, span = 0.8) {
  
  df_high_b <- df_trend_b %>%
    filter(group == "outcome")
  
  df_other_b <- df_trend_b %>%
    filter(group == "experience")
  
  if (nrow(df_high_b) < 5 || nrow(df_other_b) < 5) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(time_grid)))
  }
  
  fit_h <- tryCatch(
    loess(
      mean ~ Time_Index,
      data = df_high_b,
      weights = n,
      span = span,
      degree = 1,
      control = loess.control(surface = "direct")
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  fit_o <- tryCatch(
    loess(
      mean ~ Time_Index,
      data = df_other_b,
      weights = n,
      span = span,
      degree = 1,
      control = loess.control(surface = "direct")
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(fit_h) || is.null(fit_o)) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(time_grid)))
  }
  
  pred_h <- tryCatch(
    predict(
      fit_h,
      newdata = data.frame(Time_Index = time_grid)
    ),
    error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(time_grid))
  )
  
  pred_o <- tryCatch(
    predict(
      fit_o,
      newdata = data.frame(Time_Index = time_grid)
    ),
    error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(time_grid))
  )
  
  pred_h - pred_o
}

df_trend_orig <- make_trend(df_final)

diff_point <- get_loess_diff(
  df_trend_b = df_trend_orig,
  time_grid = time_grid,
  span = loess_span
)

boot_diff <- replicate(B, {
  
  boot_df <- df_final %>%
    slice_sample(
      n = nrow(df_final),
      replace = TRUE
    )
  
  df_trend_b <- make_trend(boot_df)
  
  get_loess_diff(
    df_trend_b = df_trend_b,
    time_grid = time_grid,
    span = loess_span
  )
})

ci_lower <- apply(
  boot_diff,
  1,
  quantile,
  probs = 0.025,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

ci_upper <- apply(
  boot_diff,
  1,
  quantile,
  probs = 0.975,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

trust_scenarios_diff <- tibble(
  Time_Index = time_grid,
  diff = diff_point,
  lower = ci_lower,
  upper = ci_upper
)

ymax_trust_scenarios <- max(abs(c(trust_scenarios_diff$lower, trust_scenarios_diff$upper, trust_scenarios_diff$diff)), na.rm = TRUE)

p_trust_scenarios_diff <- ggplot(trust_scenarios_diff, aes(x = Time_Index, y = diff)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
    fill = "gray80",
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    color = "darkred",
    linetype = 'dashed',
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_line(
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 2
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = time_grid,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-ymax_trust_scenarios, ymax_trust_scenarios),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05)),
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    title = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "white"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5)
  )

print(p_trust_scenarios_diff)

# CT

set.seed(42)

B <- 2000
time_grid <- seq(1, 13, by = 1)
loess_span <- 0.8

make_trend <- function(data) {
  
  data %>%
    mutate(
      group = ifelse(Learning + Work >= 70, "outcome", "experience"),
      Time_Index = as.numeric(first_regular_quarter)
    ) %>%
    group_by(group, Time_Index) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = mean(AI_CT_F, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = sum(!is.na(AI_CT_F)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(mean), n > 0) %>%
    arrange(group, Time_Index)
}

get_loess_diff <- function(df_trend_b, time_grid, span = 0.8) {
  
  df_high_b <- df_trend_b %>%
    filter(group == "outcome")
  
  df_other_b <- df_trend_b %>%
    filter(group == "experience")
  
  if (nrow(df_high_b) < 5 || nrow(df_other_b) < 5) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(time_grid)))
  }
  
  fit_h <- tryCatch(
    loess(
      mean ~ Time_Index,
      data = df_high_b,
      weights = n,
      span = span,
      degree = 1,
      control = loess.control(surface = "direct")
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  fit_o <- tryCatch(
    loess(
      mean ~ Time_Index,
      data = df_other_b,
      weights = n,
      span = span,
      degree = 1,
      control = loess.control(surface = "direct")
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(fit_h) || is.null(fit_o)) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(time_grid)))
  }
  
  pred_h <- tryCatch(
    predict(
      fit_h,
      newdata = data.frame(Time_Index = time_grid)
    ),
    error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(time_grid))
  )
  
  pred_o <- tryCatch(
    predict(
      fit_o,
      newdata = data.frame(Time_Index = time_grid)
    ),
    error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(time_grid))
  )
  
  pred_h - pred_o
}

df_trend_orig <- make_trend(df_final)

diff_point <- get_loess_diff(
  df_trend_b = df_trend_orig,
  time_grid = time_grid,
  span = loess_span
)

boot_diff <- replicate(B, {
  
  boot_df <- df_final %>%
    slice_sample(
      n = nrow(df_final),
      replace = TRUE
    )
  
  df_trend_b <- make_trend(boot_df)
  
  get_loess_diff(
    df_trend_b = df_trend_b,
    time_grid = time_grid,
    span = loess_span
  )
})

ci_lower <- apply(
  boot_diff,
  1,
  quantile,
  probs = 0.025,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

ci_upper <- apply(
  boot_diff,
  1,
  quantile,
  probs = 0.975,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

CT_scenarios_diff <- tibble(
  Time_Index = time_grid,
  diff = diff_point,
  lower = ci_lower,
  upper = ci_upper
)

ymax_CT_scenarios <- max(abs(c(CT_scenarios_diff$lower, CT_scenarios_diff$upper, CT_scenarios_diff$diff)), na.rm = TRUE)

p_CT_scenarios_diff <- ggplot(CT_scenarios_diff, aes(x = Time_Index, y = diff)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
    fill = "gray80",
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    color = "darkred",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_line(
    color = "#56C596",
    linewidth = 2
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = time_grid,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-ymax_CT_scenarios, ymax_CT_scenarios),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05)),
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    title = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "white"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5)
  )

print(p_CT_scenarios_diff)
```

```{r Study 4: Task Types}
extract_coefs <- function(mod, col_name) {
  lavaan::parameterEstimates(mod) %>%
    dplyr::filter(label %in% coef_order) %>%
    dplyr::select(label, est, pvalue) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      !!paste0(col_name, "_est") := est,
      !!paste0(col_name, "_p") := pvalue
    )
}

#-----variable trajectory difference test----

# trust

set.seed(42)

B <- 2000
time_grid <- seq(1, 13, by = 1)
loess_span <- 0.8

make_trend <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      group = ifelse(Analysis + Knowledge_Inquiry + Optimization >= 60, "constrained", "openended"),
      Time_Index = as.numeric(first_regular_quarter)
    ) %>%
    group_by(group, Time_Index) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = mean(F_trust, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = sum(!is.na(F_trust)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(mean), n > 0) %>%
    arrange(group, Time_Index)
}

get_loess_diff <- function(df_trend_b, time_grid, span = 0.8) {
  
  df_high_b <- df_trend_b %>%
    filter(group == "constrained")
  
  df_other_b <- df_trend_b %>%
    filter(group == "openended")
  
  if (nrow(df_high_b) < 5 || nrow(df_other_b) < 5) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(time_grid)))
  }
  
  fit_h <- tryCatch(
    loess(
      mean ~ Time_Index,
      data = df_high_b,
      weights = n,
      span = span,
      degree = 1,
      control = loess.control(surface = "direct")
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  fit_o <- tryCatch(
    loess(
      mean ~ Time_Index,
      data = df_other_b,
      weights = n,
      span = span,
      degree = 1,
      control = loess.control(surface = "direct")
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(fit_h) || is.null(fit_o)) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(time_grid)))
  }
  
  pred_h <- tryCatch(
    predict(
      fit_h,
      newdata = data.frame(Time_Index = time_grid)
    ),
    error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(time_grid))
  )
  
  pred_o <- tryCatch(
    predict(
      fit_o,
      newdata = data.frame(Time_Index = time_grid)
    ),
    error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(time_grid))
  )
  
  pred_h - pred_o
}

df_trend_orig <- make_trend(df_final)

diff_point <- get_loess_diff(
  df_trend_b = df_trend_orig,
  time_grid = time_grid,
  span = loess_span
)

boot_diff <- replicate(B, {
  
  boot_df <- df_final %>%
    slice_sample(
      n = nrow(df_final),
      replace = TRUE
    )
  
  df_trend_b <- make_trend(boot_df)
  
  get_loess_diff(
    df_trend_b = df_trend_b,
    time_grid = time_grid,
    span = loess_span
  )
})

ci_lower <- apply(
  boot_diff,
  1,
  quantile,
  probs = 0.025,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

ci_upper <- apply(
  boot_diff,
  1,
  quantile,
  probs = 0.975,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

trust_tasks_diff <- tibble(
  Time_Index = time_grid,
  diff = diff_point,
  lower = ci_lower,
  upper = ci_upper
)

ymax_trust_tasks <- max(abs(c(trust_tasks_diff$lower, trust_tasks_diff$upper, trust_tasks_diff$diff)), na.rm = TRUE)

p_trust_tasks_diff <- ggplot(trust_tasks_diff, aes(x = Time_Index, y = diff)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
    fill = "gray80",
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    color = "darkred",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_line(
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 2
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = time_grid,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-ymax_trust_tasks, ymax_trust_tasks),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05)),
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    title = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "white"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5)

# Embeddedness

set.seed(42)

B <- 2000
time_grid <- seq(1, 13, by = 1)
loess_span <- 0.8

make_trend <- function(data) {
  
  data %>%
    mutate(
      group = ifelse(Analysis + Knowledge_Inquiry + Optimization >= 60, "constrained", "openended"),
      Time_Index = as.numeric(first_regular_quarter)
    ) %>%
    group_by(group, Time_Index) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = mean(embed_F, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = sum(!is.na(embed_F)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(mean), n > 0) %>%
    arrange(group, Time_Index)
}

get_loess_diff <- function(df_trend_b, time_grid, span = 0.8) {
  
  df_high_b <- df_trend_b %>%
    filter(group == "constrained")
  
  df_other_b <- df_trend_b %>%
    filter(group == "openended")
  
  if (nrow(df_high_b) < 5 || nrow(df_other_b) < 5) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(time_grid)))
  }
  
  fit_h <- tryCatch(
    loess(
      mean ~ Time_Index,
      data = df_high_b,
      weights = n,
      span = span,
      degree = 1,
      control = loess.control(surface = "direct")
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  fit_o <- tryCatch(
    loess(
      mean ~ Time_Index,
      data = df_other_b,
      weights = n,
      span = span,
      degree = 1,
      control = loess.control(surface = "direct")
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(fit_h) || is.null(fit_o)) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(time_grid)))
  }
  
  pred_h <- tryCatch(
    predict(
      fit_h,
      newdata = data.frame(Time_Index = time_grid)
    ),
    error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(time_grid))
  )
  
  pred_o <- tryCatch(
    predict(
      fit_o,
      newdata = data.frame(Time_Index = time_grid)
    ),
    error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(time_grid))
  )
  
  pred_h - pred_o
}

df_trend_orig <- make_trend(df_final)

diff_point <- get_loess_diff(
  df_trend_b = df_trend_orig,
  time_grid = time_grid,
  span = loess_span
)

boot_diff <- replicate(B, {
  
  boot_df <- df_final %>%
    slice_sample(
      n = nrow(df_final),
      replace = TRUE
    )
  
  df_trend_b <- make_trend(boot_df)
  
  get_loess_diff(
    df_trend_b = df_trend_b,
    time_grid = time_grid,
    span = loess_span
  )
})

ci_lower <- apply(
  boot_diff,
  1,
  quantile,
  probs = 0.025,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

ci_upper <- apply(
  boot_diff,
  1,
  quantile,
  probs = 0.975,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

embed_tasks_diff <- tibble(
  Time_Index = time_grid,
  diff = diff_point,
  lower = ci_lower,
  upper = ci_upper
)

ymax_embed_tasks <- max(abs(c(embed_tasks_diff$lower, embed_tasks_diff$upper, embed_tasks_diff$diff)), na.rm = TRUE)

p_embed_tasks_diff <- ggplot(embed_tasks_diff, aes(x = Time_Index, y = diff)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
    fill = "gray80",
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    color = "darkred",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_line(
    color = "#6B9BD1" ,
    linewidth = 2
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = time_grid,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-ymax_embed_tasks, ymax_embed_tasks),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05)),
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    title = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "white"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5)
  )

print(p_embed_tasks_diff)
```
